subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Spill the beans
solution:
The correct answer is '**Reveal a secret**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**Spill the beans**" means to disclose a secret or to reveal private or confidential information. (राज खोलना)

 
 
• **Example**: After much coaxing, he **spilled the beans** about their surprise party.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning is “**Reveal a secret**”.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To make fun of someone** means to laugh at or tease someone in a scornful or mocking manner. (किसी का मज़ाक उड़ाना)

 
 
• **Example**: It is not polite **to make fun of someone's** appearance.
 
 
 
• **Not that difficult to comprehend** implies something is easy to understand or straightforward. (समझना मुश्किल नहीं है)
 
 
• **Example**: The concept of gravity is **not that difficult to comprehend** with the right explanation.
 
 
 
• **Act rudely to someone** means to behave in an impolite or discourteous manner towards someone. (किसी के प्रति असभ्य व्यवहार करना)
 
 
• **Example**: It's never acceptable to **act rudely to someone**, no matter the circumstances.
